title: Swerve
lines: Reflex is a high traction coverstock designed to transfer greater amounts of energy directly to the core through its enhanced crosslink dense polymer.
For the Swerve core, we lowered the strength of the Mass Bias to make it more driller friendly and allow the core to perfom well for the masses.
This core yields a slightly stronger mid-lane read than the typical symmetrical shape, while maintaining the predictability symmetrical balls provide.
